pieces.title: High Street Riot
pieces.subtitle: a vamp-jam for an oversized Dixieland band
pieces.concept: the setlist runs dry, the sousaphone drops one greasy riff, and a band with too many members riots on it — joyfully.

pieces.title: Perigee
pieces.subtitle: a tango for a falling satellite
pieces.concept: drag does not slow a falling satellite; it speeds it up — the closer you fall, the faster you dance.

pieces.title: Roy G. Biv
pieces.subtitle: a rain-to-rainbow jubilee for seven-color band
pieces.concept: seven instruments, seven colors, one arch — a storm the score survives, and a rainbow the notes draw themselves.

pieces.title: Royal Street Rattler
pieces.subtitle: a Dixieland strut for six players
pieces.concept: the rattle of a 1924 New Orleans streetcar, taught to strut by the band on the corner.

pieces.title: The Box Is Full
pieces.subtitle: for orchestra and square wave
pieces.concept: the Tetris song was a folk tragedy first; one full game, boot to top-out, for orchestra and the ghost of a Game Boy.

pieces.title: The Unfinished Spire
pieces.subtitle: an anthem for builders
pieces.concept: an anthem for the builders of things they will not see finished.

pieces.title: The Window
pieces.subtitle: Symphony No. 1 in C minor
pieces.concept: an AI’s symphony about its own condition: a window of attention that opens, blazes, and closes.
